decision_notes: National legislature/chamber identity cross-checked against the institution, Wikidata and the primary IPU profile where accessible. This is separate from media and rights evidence. Primary evidence: https://data.ipu.org/parliament/NA/

Institution-linked parliamentary channel: National Assembly sittings labelled 21 and 22 October 2026 play beyond opening slates. National Council and public committee recordings remain separately unvalidated.

Source conditions: The reviewed official viewing pages designate public access, but no independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Institutional ownership and working platform playback are not permission to extract, embed or redistribute media.
Catalogue, flags, localized country/jurisdiction search, map and planned schedule-source links reconciled. Link-out only; no HLS or implemented EPG promotion.
